description: Combined with your purchase, sales, and inventory business data, you can achieve batch reconciliation, sales invoicing, and batch product creation, covering various business scenarios such as sales, procurement, inventory, cashier, reconciliation, and operational analysis.

examples_en: Please look up the customer with the highest outstanding balance and send me their statement of account (PDF) for this month.
